source: Drone 1 with the tilt pivots raised 20 mm (geometry_2026-11-12_raised.json: the CAD estimate, masses not weighed), refitted by sw/sim/identify_airframe.py on every post-raise flight (2026-11-11 22:57-23:35 UTC indoor hops with and without the bands, 2026-11-12 00:46-02:27 outdoor hovers, the roll-step ladders and the flip's hover before it; 32 flights, 930 s airborne), from airframe_2026-11-12_flip.json and pulled toward it (--prior, weight 0.3), the flip's terms frozen. What moved: the right motor's static gain 1.111 -> 1.068 (the thrust split), the steady pitch push -0.88 -> -4.74 rad/s^2 (it takes back the CAD's 2.45 mm forward CoM shift: the drone's CoM sits about where the hover fits had it), the yaw push 3.5 -> 0.9, servo_compliance 0 -> 0.0047, pitch_pendulum 0.004 -> 0.008, wash 0.72 -> 0.70, edgewise_damping 0.074 -> 0.064; the rest within a few percent. Then the flip's terms on this geometry (sw/sim/flip_replay.py, 9.85-11.0 s): free, rotor_momentum 0.0122 (+-0.0013), motor_coast 0.175, inflow_damping 0.085, yaw_from_roll 0.0044; held here at 0.018 (physics about 0.02, the hover's prop_momentum 0.0154) with motor_coast 0.1865, inflow_damping 0.0617, yaw_from_roll 0.0061 refitted (cost 1.506 against 1.477 free). On this geometry the flip as flown is clean in flip_firmware.py up to rotor_momentum 0.034 and fails as it did only from about 0.042: models/NOTES.md 'Raised pivots'.
